tweet.text:
Looking to enter $DMAGA around this area (45m). We saw a crazy run up yesterday, and a correction/consolidation is extremely healthy. 

⁍ People are changing their PFPs simply because they look amazing and also to follow Elon’s footsteps. 

⁍ The more PFPs changed, the more the clean vibrant red and blue dominate the timeline and notification.

⁍ Better distribution between early buyers and new holders today. 

⁍ Sell pressure is decreasing and any shock in buy volume could break this out of the triangle. 

⁍ Could dominate the Trump coin side of SOL, competing with MAGA on ETH (300m). This has better culture in my opinion. 

Could go down to the .382 fib (33m), so will add more there if we get there. 

Good luck, have fun 🫡
